en.heroIntro: I am a postgraduate in Linguistics and Applied Linguistics at Peking University, now working as an independent researcher and entrepreneur, building a Neo-Lab, Monticule Tech. I am striding towards becoming an LLM full-stack engineer, focusing on continual learning and personal models that swiftly adapt the foundation to diverse domains and align with inherent human preferences.

zh.heroIntro: 北京大学外国语言学及应用语言学硕士，独立研究者与Neo Lab创业者，正在创办蒙迪丘（Monticule Tech）。我正努力成长为一名 LLM 全栈工程师，关注持续学习与个人模型，让基座模型快速适配多种垂直领域，并真正对齐人类内在偏好。
